This rule replaces the earlier ticket-lifespan description:
Whenever someone mints using a referral code, the referrer immediately receives 7 tickets on their NFT:
+4 Small Block Tickets
+3 Big Block Tickets

These feed two completely independent counters: one Small Block counter and one Big Block counter.

For the Small Block ($7,200 pool ÷ 8 ÷ $900 draw), draw only from Small Block Tickets issued since the previous small block. After the draw, burn and reset all Small Block Tickets to 0.

For the Big Block ($216,000 pool ÷ 9 ÷ $24,000 draw), draw only from Big Block Tickets issued since the previous big block. After the draw, burn and reset all Big Block Tickets to 0.

Small blocks therefore stay fair and fresh because old tickets do not carry forward, while Big Block entries accumulate naturally until that block is drawn. Metadata only needs to show the two counters plus permanent badges.

The triggers remain pool-based: the small block fires when its pool reaches exactly $7,200, and the big block fires when its pool reaches exactly $216,000. Secondary royalties continue to fill the pools but do not create tickets.

Everything else remains the same: the $10 commission is automatic, a ticket goes to a random existing NFT when no referral code is used, and prize claims remain manual.

Page Title: About Harbor Quill

What is Harbor Quill?
Harbor Quill serves as the live proof of concept for CORA (Community Outreach Response Automation), the first system allowing independent creators to sell unlimited-mint NFT ebooks while paying readers genuine commissions and prize tickets for sharing them.
It launches on Base with my own raw memoir novella, “From Workshop Floor to Fresh Start,” and represents my public mission to help my household's recovery after a six-figure property fraud.

Mint Your ebook NFT

Share the link or mint number. Every mint that uses it immediately earns you $10 USD, with no limits or expiration.

Our Vision
Although Harbor Quill begins with one book, it is intended as only the first step.
The vision is a world where ebooks succeed according to merit, without gatekeepers or Amazon algorithms suppressing independent voices. Unknown and established creators alike should rise because audiences connect with their work—not because they manipulate a platform, have privileged connections, or purchase enough advertising.
Fans should be compensated for word-of-mouth promotion they previously provided for free, while anyone willing to hustle can earn after discovering a worthwhile title to share.

Our goal is a self-sustaining system that serves everyone: artists receive a fair share, fans and affiliates create real income, and communities form direct relationships.
